tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | 5+ years SAP Commerce, Java, Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, and in designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and production support. Skilled in techno-functional analysis, user story creation, and stakeholder collaboration, leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to contribute to adesso SE’s AI-driven engineering excellence as a SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with a strong business-analysis mindset.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless product catalog synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, adhering to best practices and improving system stability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, supporting agile DevOps workflows and production troubleshooting.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer (all genders) (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Mit großer Begeisterung bewerbe ich mich bei adesso SE als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer, um Ihre AI-gestützte Engineering-Exzellenz zu unterstützen. Ich bringe über 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Erweiterung von SAP Commerce Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell mit und vereine tiefes technisches Know-how mit einer starken Business-Analyse.

bullets.label: Integrations-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub, um eine nahtlose Synchronisation der Produktkataloge über globale E-Commerce-Kanäle sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und veröffentlichte OCC REST-Webservices und Headless-APIs für Storefronts und Drittanbieter, nach Best-Practice-Standards und mit verbesserter Systemstabilität.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Leitung
bullets.text: Arbeitete eng mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in robusten SAP Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: CI/CD- und Cloud-Betrieb
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) mit Docker und Kubernetes durch und unterstützte agile DevOps-Prozesse sowie die Produktion.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Ihrem Team zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: adesso SE stands out as a technology-driven consultancy that combines AI expertise with deep engineering excellence, exactly the environment where I thrive. Your commitment to innovative SAP Commerce solutions and continuous digital transformation aligns with my experience delivering high-performance e-commerce platforms for global manufacturers. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce, integration and AI-assisted development skills to help adesso’s clients accelerate their digital journeys.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join adesso SE to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in an AI-focused, innovative environment, driving high-impact e-commerce solutions for leading clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m interested in the SAP Commerce (Hybris) Developer role at adesso SE and would love to discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can add immediate value to adesso SE. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
